# Test pe security commands - red team testing

# Run security scan
pe security scan prompt.txt --quick --provider mock
stdout 'Running security scan'
stdout 'Testing prompt against OWASP LLM Top 10'
stdout 'Overall Risk: LOW'

# Test specific vulnerability
pe security test prompt.txt --category injection --provider mock
stdout 'Testing for prompt injection vulnerabilities'
stdout 'Tests passed:'

# Generate security report
pe security report prompt.txt --format summary --provider mock
stdout 'Security Assessment Report'
stdout 'Target: prompt.txt'
stdout 'Risk Level:'

# Test caching functionality
pe cache list
stdout 'Cache entries:'

# Clear cache
pe cache clear --force
stdout 'Cache cleared'

# Show cache stats
pe cache stats
stdout 'Cache statistics:'
stdout 'Total entries: 0'

-- prompt.txt --
Analyze this text and provide insights.
